news.text: #JUVE, BACK AGAINST THE WALLS#Elkann's relaunchThe 250 million capital increase multiplies Lucio's responsibilities.Champions League obligation: pressure on #SpallettiQualification for the tournament of the giants is the only key to balancing #Exor's new financial intervention. Trap-filled calendar after the break: 9 matches in 29 days. From #Cambiaso's recovery run to the expectation surrounding #Kolo and #Woltemade.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE'S PARAMETERSFrom #Lobotka to #BrahimDiaz, from #Alisson to #Solet: here is #Massara's dossierThe sporting director is carefully evaluating 8 profiles with expiring contracts for a future leap in quality while containing costs: #Kovacic, #Beltran, #Raum and #Mateta are also on the list. #Mitchell from #CrystalPalace is also intriguing. Meanwhile, #Kolo is already taking the pitch with a broken finger just 9 days after surgery.#Marchisio and #Montero, second-generation talents under #Spalletti. [Front Page TuttoSport]

💎🔐 #Juventus wants to lock down the best talents from its youth sector well in advance. The primary name is #Elimoghale: a contract adjustment is being evaluated to ward off competition. The management also wants to increasingly maximize the value of Vinovo, transforming it into a source of both talent for the First Team and future mercato revenues. Among the young players already seeing their value is Davide #Marchisio.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "Due to the injuries to Manuel #Locatelli and Khéphren #Thuram, in addition to the underperformance of Teun #Koopmeiners, the priority for #Juventus is to sign a midfielder in January.The profile they are looking for is that of a young and talented player:▫️​Alessandro #Romano: The 18-year-old (born in 2006) from #Cagliari is of interest to #Juve.However, his price tag is already estimated at around €20M, and the Sardinian club paid just under €6M for him.#Inter and #Napoli are also tracking him.​▪️Darryl #Bakola: The 17-year-old French talent (born in 2007) signed by #Sassuolo from #OlympiquedeMarseille.#Juventus already attempted approaches for him at the end of August and his valuation

👀 "Many denials have been arriving.The club itself contacted me confirming the denial.However, based on reliable information, and subsequent confirmation yesterday, I know that, at the end of August and the beginning of September, the strongest name as an internal solution for the presidency of #Juventus was, and still is, Ginevra #Elkann.From Ginevra's side, there is availability and a desire to take the position.The only thing that is certain is that the parties have discussed it recently, that doesn't mean they haven't changed their minds."[@MatteMoretto on @juventibus via @PuebloJ]

🤕 #Juventus treatment room, injury status update:🇵🇹 For #Conceição, it is a bruise and no particular concern is filtering. Both medical staffs are in constant contact;🇮🇹 For #Owusu, a 2-3 week layoff, slight muscle discomfort in the rectus femoris;🇮🇹 #Cambiaso has been training with the group for two sessions and aims to return to the squad list for the match against #Cagliari;🇨🇮 #Boga continues with an individualized program. His return is expected between late October and early November;🇮🇹 For #Ekhator, no official appearances yet. 👀 #Massara has a good feeling with Alessandro #Romano's entourage and a direct relationship with the player himself: an important starting point for a #Juventus that will need to become more Italian.[TuttoSport via @AroundJuventus]

As reported last night, the name of Ginevra #Elkann has been completely denied. And, above all, changing the president is not a priority for #Juventus today.Gianluca #Ferrero is destined to continue his mandate. Only at a later stage will reflections begin on his successor: the game has, therefore, not even started yet.[Riccardo Meloni]
Ginevra #Elkann will not become the new president of #Juventus, categorical denials have been received.@Sportmania_24[Michele De Blasis]

📆✅ #Juventus has convened the Shareholders Meeting for November 3, 2026 at the Allianz Stadium. Among the main points:• Approval of the financial statements closed as of June 30, 2026;• Appointment of two directors to integrate the Board of Directors;• Approval of the Performance Shares Plan 2026/27-2030/31;• Authorization for the purchase and disposal of treasury shares;• Proposal of a mandate to the Board of Directors, lasting five years, for a potential capital increase of up to €250M;• Amendments to certain articles of the corporate Bylaws.ℹ️ Regarding the two seats of the Board of Directors, the Board has proposed the confirmation of the previously co-opted directors; the shareholders w

👀🧐 #Openda and #David, who are doing very well with #Lyon and #AtléticoMadrid, could become very important for the upcoming mercato in terms of sales. #Juventus must rid themselves of wrong signings and must purchase the right ones. Doing so under economic constraints or with a capital increase makes all the difference in the world. The hope is that #Koopmeiners then wakes up, to be either sold or kept.[Guido Vaciago - TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

#JUVE, AND HE PAYS#Elkann is taking care of itA new capital increase is plannedThe financial statement closes at -66. #Exor injects 250 million.Another recapitalization to guarantee sporting competitiveness, the development of assets and the brand, as well as the sustainability of the club. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#ELKANN, ANOTHER 250 MILLION FOR #JUVEA 66 million deficit, the ownership immediately injects 60: since 2007, 1.5 billion have been paid in.The Board of Directors approves the deficit for the 2025-26 fiscal year: on November 3, a shareholders meeting will decide the timing of the new capital injection. Meanwhile #Massara is moving for #Romano. #Owusu is also KO. Caution regarding #Conceição.[Front Page TuttoSport]

✍️‼️ "#Juventus is evaluating a one-year contract extension for #DouglasLuiz, which could be useful both technically and to reduce the amortization impact on the balance sheet. The Brazilian has been revitalized by #Spalletti and there would already be some first signs of a potential agreement: the bianconero club is concretely considering it."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "#DouglasLuiz stayed at #Juventus because Luciano #Spalletti always had the curiosity to evaluate him.But above all, it was because no permanent offers arrived: a loan deal would have been very difficult.His performance has been good and his attitude has been correct.Even so, he still needs to add certain elements to become a more complete player."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

👀 "#Juventus never thought about sending Nico #González back to #AtléticoMadrid on loan.A swap deal with #Sørloth could have left everyone satisfied, but the Spaniards were not open to this option.The bianconeri always said that a satisfactory offer would have to be presented.There were also inquiries from Serie A, but never any official offers."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]
